description: Counts of buildings predicted damaged by the Microsoft AI for Good Lab damage-assessment models, aggregated to H3 resolution-9 hexagons (about 0.086 km2 each, roughly 290 m across) per imagery assessment. Four assessments are included as separate rows for the same cell: Vantor (formerly Maxar) satellite imagery of 2025-10-29 (St Elizabeth strip, 107,133 footprints of which 64,652 cloud-obscured) and 2025-10-31 (St James / Montego Bay, 61,161 footprints), and NOAA NGS aerial imagery of 2025-11-01 (Westmoreland, 34,403) and 2025-11-02 (labelled St Elizabeth by the publisher but 30,091 of 30,545 footprints fall in Westmoreland parish). 11,101 rows over 10,916 cells; 233,242 footprints; 81,299 predicted damaged. damaged in the source is binary (roof visibly damaged from above); the four n_damaged_* bins are CARTO's split of the publisher's damage_pct_0m and are derived. Individual footprints are deliberately not published (privacy decision for this demo). A cell with no row was either not imaged, cloud-covered or had no footprints: absence of detection is not absence of damage. Source: Hurricane Melissa: Building Damage Assessment in Jamaica (HDX), retrieved 2026-09-23.

table:columns.name: h3_index
table:columns.description: H3 resolution-9 cell id, 15-character string such as 8945b2a2ac3ffff; 10,916 distinct, 185 appear twice (two assessments).

table:columns.name: assessment_id
table:columns.description: One of vantor-20251029-st-elizabeth, vantor-20251031-st-james, noaa-20251101a-westmoreland, noaa-20251102a-st-elizabeth (CARTO's ids; the parish in the id is the publisher's label, not the COD-AB parish).

table:columns.name: imagery_date
table:columns.description: Imagery acquisition date from the HDX resource description / file name: 2025-10-29, 2025-10-31, 2025-11-01 or 2025-11-02.

table:columns.name: imagery_provider
table:columns.description: Vantor (formerly Maxar) or NOAA NGS, from the HDX methodology text.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the HDX GeoPackage the rows were aggregated from.

table:columns.name: n_buildings
table:columns.description: Footprints whose centroid falls in the cell (1-387; total 233,242).

table:columns.name: n_assessed
table:columns.description: Footprints with unknown_pct = 0 in the source, or all footprints for the NOAA files (no cloud column); total 151,837.

table:columns.name: n_cloud_obscured
table:columns.description: Footprints with unknown_pct > 0 (share of the footprint under cloud); reproduces the publisher's 64,652 for 2025-10-29; total 81,405; always 0 for NOAA rows.

table:columns.name: n_damaged
table:columns.description: Footprints with source damaged = 1, which is exactly damage_pct_0m > 0 in all four files; total 81,299.

table:columns.name: n_damaged_assessed
table:columns.description: damaged = 1 and not cloud-obscured; total 77,634.

table:columns.name: n_intact_assessed
table:columns.description: damaged = 0 and not cloud-obscured (publisher: intact, roof on).

table:columns.name: n_damaged_lt25
table:columns.description: Derived bin (CARTO, not a publisher class): damaged = 1 with damage_pct_0m < 0.25; total 31,302.

table:columns.name: n_damaged_25_50
table:columns.description: Derived bin: damaged = 1 with 0.25 <= damage_pct_0m < 0.5; total 14,015.

table:columns.name: n_damaged_50_75
table:columns.description: Derived bin: damaged = 1 with 0.5 <= damage_pct_0m < 0.75; total 12,867.

table:columns.name: n_damaged_gte75
table:columns.description: Derived bin: damaged = 1 with damage_pct_0m >= 0.75; total 23,115.

table:columns.name: n_debris_within_20m
table:columns.description: Footprints with damage_pct_20m > 0 (share of a 20 m buffer predicted damaged: nearby debris); Vantor files only, NULL for NOAA rows (35,166 for 2025-10-29, 43,141 for 2025-10-31).

table:columns.name: mean_damage_pct_damaged
table:columns.description: Mean damage_pct_0m over the cell's damaged footprints (0-1).

table:columns.name: share_damaged
table:columns.description: n_damaged_assessed / n_assessed, 0-1; NULL when n_assessed = 0 (3,625 rows). Quartiles 0.0 / 0.286 / 0.591. The default style grades this column.

table:columns.name: adm1_name
table:columns.description: OCHA COD-AB parish name (Saint Elizabeth, Westmoreland, Saint James, Hanover, Trelawny), the mode over the cell's footprints; a border cell is attributed whole to one parish.

table:columns.name: adm1_pcode
table:columns.description: COD-AB parish P-code JM01..JM14 of adm1_name; joins to building-damage-parishes and to the ocha-cod-jamaica parishes.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: H3 resolution-9 cell boundary polygon, WGS 84 longitude/latitude (EPSG:4326); extent -78.347, 17.859, -77.667, 18.484.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: GeoParquet bbox covering column (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added by the conversion.
